detail: Read help (age F0-F3, slow, aborig, girl labels) and first rows. Quine's school-absence data, one row per child (id unique 1-146); the remaining columns are a 4x2x2x2 factorial design (negative-binomial GLM), no repeated sampling cluster.
Read help and first rows. Wide repeated-measures: y1-y4 are four occasions as columns, one row per dose/weight cell; the within-subject grouping unit is no column of the table (#23 wide-table rule).
Read help (treat labels) and first rows. Wide repeated-measures: weight1 (pre) and weight2 (post) are two occasions as columns, one row per patient (#23 wide-table rule).
Read help and first rows. Wooldridge class-attendance data, one row per student; all columns are student-level attributes with no repeated cluster column.

Read help (no labels) and first rows. A frequency-weighted mobility table (freq constant within id, two brothers 0/1 per family id); no do-file model and no defensible single response column (time is an occupation code, freq a cell weight).
Read help and first rows. Wide repeated-measures: rfn/rfc/rfi/rcn/rcc/rci are six condition columns per subject, one row per subject (subj unique 1-24) (#23 wide-table rule).
Read ch15.do (stset dur, failure(divorce) id(id); streg ..., single-level AFT/Cox, no shared frailty) and first rows. One row per respondent (id unique); survival data with no repeated cluster.

Read help labels and first rows. Wide multi-span format: time1-time17 and numkid1-numkid17 are the fertility spans as columns, one row per respondent (#23 wide-table rule); the long per-span versions are divorce/divorce2.
Read help labels (w1sesl_m = 'aggregated mean ses from child level'). One row per school, aggregated up from ecls_child; a derived summary of another object of this source.

Read help (no labels) and first rows. Meta-analysis of 19 teacher-expectancy studies, one row per study (est, se); the study-level effect is an observation-level random effect, no within-study replication.
Read ch1.do: only regress (OLS) fits, no random term; faculty salary data, one row per faculty member with no cluster column.
Read help (no labels) and first rows. Age-at-first-intercourse survival in person format, one row per subject (id unique); no repeated person-period cluster in the loaded table.
Read help labels and first rows. Wooldridge cross-sectional worker fringe-benefits data, one row per worker; industry appears only as a handful of ind1-ind9 dummies (covariates), no sampled cluster.
Read help labels and first rows. Wide repeated-measures: gpa1-gpa6 and job1-job6 are six semesters as columns, one row per student (#23 wide-table rule).
Read help and first rows. Wide two-grader reliability subset of essays: grade1 and grade4 are two graders as columns, one row per essay (#23 wide-table rule).
Read help and first rows. Frets' head-dimensions data, length1/breadth1/length2/breadth2 are first- and second-son measurements as columns, one row per family (#23 wide-table rule).
